description: This source file defines the ScriptEventHandler class, which implements an event handler using scripting (JSR-223) to execute scripts or script functions in response to web events within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages the setup of execution context, invocation of scripts, and handling of script results, with focus on web request processing.

classes.name: ScriptEventHandler
classes.description: A final class implementing EventHandler that utilizes javax.script for executing scripts as event responses within a web application.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the event handler with the servlet context. No specific setup needed in this implementation.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Executes a script or script function in response to an event, passing in web request, response, session, and other contextual data, and handling the result or errors accordingly.
